content_of_post_to_answer: What is one mindset that helps you stay focused on your own growth instead of seeking validation from others?
answer: A useful shift is to stop seeing validation as a reward and start seeing it as data. Other people's opinions can reveal something, but they cannot define the direction of your growth. The difficult part is learning to separate feedback that improves your work from approval that temporarily soothes insecurity. Growth becomes easier when your standards come from your values, not from constantly checking whether others are impressed.
